messages.content: Extract explicit travel claims as JSON {"claims":[{"predicate":...,"value":...,"action":"assert" or "supersede","reason":...,"source_quote":...}]}. Use ONLY predicate,value,action,reason,source_quote keys in each claim; no meta, kind, subject, scope or other extra keys. Every claim requires a verbatim source_quote containing its value AND field/units/qualifiers. Copy literal source words; do not paraphrase or infer missing values. Cover every explicit requirement, including each field in a coordinated update. If any requirement is unclear/unsupported, return claims:[] for the entire message. Do not create empty values, diagnoses, identity/authority, protection or targets. The application supplies subject, scope and kinds. Only explicit changes supersede; ordinary/repeated preferences assert. A usual diet is a preference. Vocabulary: {"destination": "fact: city name copied from source", "dates": "fact: YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD", "budget": "rule: numeric TOTAL budget, no per-person/night amount", "currency": "fact: explicit INR/USD/EUR/GBP", "departure_city": "fact: city copied from source", "traveller_count": "rule: explicit integer party size", "dietary": "rule for a trip requirement; preference for usual food preferences", "pace": "preference: active/relaxed if explicit", "interests": "preference: array of literal interests", "seat_preference": "preference: aisle/window", "accessibility": "rule: explicit step-free/wheelchair-accessible requirement", "max_walk_metres": "rule: integer maximum walking distance in metres", "avoid_boats": "rule: boolean; true for no boats, false for boats explicitly allowed", "max_activities_per_day": "rule: integer daily limit", "flight_time_preference": "rule: morning/afternoon/evening", "activity_preferences": "preference: literal string or array of activities", "hotel_preference": "preference: literal hotel style", "mood": "preference: explicitly stated current mood; never a diagnosis"}. Trusted context: {"subject": "Riya", "scope": {}}
Usually I prefer vegetarian food, an active pace, an aisle seat, and interests in hiking, boat rides and local food.
